criteria_in_order.criterion: maximise mean CV ROC-AUC across the 50 folds
tie within 1e-6 -> maximise mean CV PR-AUC
tie within 1e-6 -> minimise mean CV Brier (calibrated)
tie within 1e-6 -> earlier in complexity_order (simpler wins)

calibration.where: fitted on out-of-fold predictions of training rows only (nested CV)
calibration.shipped_probability_rule: ship calibrated probability if CV Brier(calibrated) <= CV Brier(raw), else ship raw; decided once on train CV and logged

quantum_admission.allowed_form: stacked/blended score with the selected classical model only
admitted_if: delta mean CV ROC-AUC >= +0.01 vs the selected classical baseline
strict improvement in at least 60% of the 10 CV repeats (paired per repeat)
computed on identical folds and identical in-fold PCA features
quantum_admission.otherwise: reject the quantum score and report 'did not help' with the measured delta

final_fit.hyperparameters: those selected by CV above; no re-tuning after seeing test

ranking.top10_flag: first 10 rows of the ranked test set; never edited afterwards

seeds.note: all stochastic components derive from this seed
